court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court No.2, Pune - P.A.No.585 of 2017
case_name: Mrs. Lisha Abhay Jagtap @ Ms. Lisha ... vs Shri. Abhay Kamalakar Jagtap @ Abhey ...
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife challenged the judgment and order dated 03.07.2018 passed by the learned Judge, Family Court No.2, Pune below exhibit-5 in P.A.No.585 of 2017. The trial court allowed the application filed by the respondent husband and directed the petitioner to handover interim custody of minor son Ayush to the respondent within 4 weeks.

legal_principles.principle: Welfare of the child is the paramount consideration in matters of custody.
legal_principles.held: He submitted that while considering the aspect of interim custody, welfare of child is the paramount consideration.

legal_principles.principle: The court may consider the conduct of the parties in granting interim custody.
legal_principles.held: He submitted that respondent and petitioner have joint custody of Ayush. Respondent drops the child to the school. The conduct of the respondent also dis-entitles him from granting of interim custody.

outcome.final_order: The learned Judge held that the petitioner is entitled to have overnight access of minor son Ayush from 6.00 p.m. of 2nd and 4th Friday till 8.00 p.m. The arrangement was ordered to remain in force till the decision of the main Petition.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for joint custody
assisting in a divorce case with minor children
